Level 3: Unambiguous in one source (no competing edition known) or several editions fit but ALL share the same tracklist -> NOT MET (discogs:release/8491193 fits title and format MC as a Various Artists Reader's Digest cassette compilation and does not share the Kastelruther Spatzen album tracklist; Polish cassette discogs:release/16402359 was also not checked). Level 2: Several editions fit the input and at least one of them has a DIFFERENT tracklist (other track count, other tracks, other artist with the same title); the choice rests on weak signals -> MET (without an artist in the input, both Kastelruther Spatzen's MC editions and the Various Artists cassette compilation discogs:release/8491193 fit the input and have different artists and tracklists; furthermore multiple Kastelruther Spatzen MC editions exist including barcode-less variants discogs:release/15349631 and discogs:release/24889304 and unchecked Polish MC discogs:release/16402359).
